summary: Mechanically the file is mostly clean (all 27 template exercise_ids resolve, every training day sums exactly to its declared 47-50 min, step numbering is contiguous, no circular gates, no equipment outside the allowed list). But it fails as an app-drivable, coach-approvable program on five load-bearing points. (1) The gate chain is unreachable in 12 weeks: hinge_deadlift is trained only on Monday with x2 per step and no advances in weeks 4/8/12, so a perfect all-step-1 user (Cat) reaches hinge step 6 in week 11 and swing step 4 (35 lb dumbbell) in week 11 and never touches the 53 lb bell; even a best-case Sean only reaches the first dead-stop 53 lb swing in week 11. Phase 2's '53 lb bell in deadlift/swing/goblet/row', Phase 3's S&S density clock, one-hand swings, 53 lb press/floor-press/get-up, Boss Battle 2's warrior/champion tiers and the 'both earning the bell' badge are all unreachable under the program's own rules. (2) Reused exercise_ids break the progression algorithm: treadmill_zone2 is logged as 3/7/8/4-minute items on Wed-warmup/Mon/Thu/Sat against a 30-min step target, so those logs either count as completions (auto-advance without ever doing 30 min) or as FAILs (<60% of 30 -> step back after two); swing on Saturday runs a different prescription (EMOM/density) under the same id, so a Thu/Sat/Thu sequence can never produce '2 consecutive sessions' at the Thursday target, and Saturday prescribes '8 DB swings' to users on steps 1-2 who have not been cleared to swing. (3) Boss Battle 2 at week 4 asks two beginners who are at swing step 1 (hike-and-park, 'no swing yet') to do 5 minutes of max continuous swings; the week-4 mile test asks people locked to walk intervals to run a mile 'as fast as possible'. (4) The 'machine-checkable grammar' is only defined for targets; advance_when, gates, placement quiz, phase parameters (RIR/tempo/Zone-2 minutes) and deload multipliers exist only as prose, 11 targets fall outside the stated grammar, and multi-load steps ('8 then 12 lb') cannot be evaluated because the per-set log has no load field. (5) Vest-gate expressions are off by one versus the ladders that unlock them, and five 53 lb steps carry no machine-readable gate. Ladders do start low enough for a smaller beginner (wall push-up, chair sit-to-stand, 8 lb press, 12 lb row/goblet, 20 lb DB hike-and-park) and weekly hard-set volume (~9-12 sets/muscle, 45 upper sets/week, ~100-175 swings/week) is sane; those parts pass. The program must not ship until the hinge/swing cadence, the id reuse, the week-4 tests and the data-model gaps are fixed.

issues.issue: 53 lb bell (BELL GATE) and everything downstream of it are unreachable inside the 12-week program under the program's own rules; the phase promises are false.
issues.evidence: hinge_deadlift appears only in Mon strength A (3 sets). Each step needs 'x2' consecutive sessions and advances are forbidden in weeks 4, 8, 12 ('none during deload/test weeks') and week 12 is a taper, leaving 9 advancing Mondays. Read-only simulation of a user who hits every threshold every session: seeded all-1 (Cat-type) reaches hinge step 2 w2, 3 w5, 4 w7, 5 w9, 6 w11; swing.1 requires hinge_deadlift.step >= 3 so swings cannot begin until Thu w5, then 2 w6, 3 w9, 4 w11 -> final swing step 4/12, never step 6. Best-case seeded Sean (hinge 2, goblet 4, push_up 4) reaches hinge 6 w9, 7 w11 and swing 6 (first dead-stop 53 lb) only on Thu w11. Yet phases claim: Phase 1 'pass the hinge gate and (for most users) the bell gate' (weeks 1-4), Phase 2 '53 lb bell in deadlift/swing/goblet/row as gates pass', Phase 3 'S&S density clock (100 swings toward 5:00), one-hand swings if earned ... get-ups with 20-35 lb'. db_floor_press.7 and db_overhead_press.9 require swing.step >= 7, turkish_get_up.7 requires swing.step >= 9, bb_swings_5min warrior/champion tiers require 53 lb, duo badge 'both earning the bell' -- all unreachable. Also 'fast progression' is contradicted: Cat does not perform a single swing until week 5 and never a bell swing.
issues.fix: Train the hinge twice a week: add hinge_deadlift (3 sets) to Thu strength A ahead of swing (drop step_up to 2 sets or move single_leg_rdl to Monday strength B in place of calf_raise's third set). Make the Saturday swing block a real swing session that counts toward steps 1-7 (see id-reuse fix). Let pure skill/checklist steps (hinge 1-2, swing 1-3, TGU 1-2) advance on x1 when checklist 5/5 and RIR >= 3, or allow same-session sub-step progression (hike-and-park -> dead-stop -> continuous within one Thursday if checklist 5/5). Allow advances in weeks 4/8 for checklist-only steps. Re-run the simulation and rewrite phase 'goal'/'what_changes' text to match what the simulator shows a perfect user reaching (target: bell gate by ~week 7-8 for a seeded-2 user, ~week 9-10 for all-1).

issues.issue: treadmill_zone2 is used as the exercise_id for 3/7/8/4-minute walks (Wed warm-up, Mon finisher, Thu finisher, Sat flush) while its ladder target is '30 min RPE <= 4'; the progression algorithm will either auto-advance the Zone-2 ladder on finisher walks or auto-regress it.
issues.evidence: weekly_template Mon conditioning item exercise_id 'treadmill_zone2' reps_or_time '7 min'; Thu '8 min'; Sat cooldown '4 min flush walk'; Wed warm-up '3 min'. progression_rules: 'the ladder step supplies reps/time/load ... advance threshold applies to every prescribed set'; 'x2 = the condition met on 2 consecutive logged sessions of that exercise'; 'SESSION FAIL: any set < 60% of the prescribed (low-end) reps/time' and '2 consecutive FAILs -> current_step -= 1'. treadmill_zone2 step 1 advance_when 'completed at RPE <= 4 x2'. A 7-min Monday log at RPE 3 is either a completion (Mon+Thu = advance every week without a 30-min session) or 7 < 18 min = FAIL (Mon+Thu = step back every week). Both are wrong.
issues.fix: Add distinct ids 'zone2_finisher' (target 'N min RPE <= 4', advance 'terminal', reads incline from treadmill_zone2 step) and 'walk_warmup'/'walk_flush', or add a per-template-item boolean 'counts_for_progression': false plus 'time_override_min'. Only Wednesday main-block logs may feed the treadmill_zone2 counter. Apply the same field to Wed warm-up.

issues.issue: swing is one exercise_id but Thursday and Saturday prescribe incompatible things; the x2 counter can never complete, and Saturday tells step-1/2 users to swing before they are cleared.
issues.evidence: Thu strength A: swing sets '5', 'ladder step target'. Sat strength B: swing sets '1', reps_or_time '8-10 min EMOM or density clock per ladder step (steps 1-5: 8-min EMOM of 8 DB swings odd minutes / 8 goblet squats even minutes)'. swing.3 target '5x10', advance 'all sets >= 10 with checklist x2' -- a Saturday log of 4x8 never satisfies '>= 10', so Thu(met)/Sat(not met)/Thu(met) is never '2 consecutive'. swing.8 target '8x10 EMOM' with how 'Saturday block; Thursday stays 5x10' -- one step, two targets, grammar cannot express it; steps 9-11 ('100 in <= 8:00') define no Thursday prescription at all. swing.1 how: 'No swing yet' and swing.2 is dead-stop singles, yet Saturday steps 1-5 run '8 DB swings' per odd minute. progression_rules: 'The template's set count always wins' would render Saturday as 1x10.
issues.fix: Split into two ids: 'swing' (Thursday sets, steps 1-7, 12) and 'swing_density' (Saturday; its own ladder: step 1 hike-and-park/goblet EMOM while swing.step <= 2, step 2 dead-stop-swing EMOM while swing.step == 2-3, step 3 8x8 DB EMOM, step 4 8x10 53 lb EMOM requires swing.step >= 7, steps 5-7 density clock 8:00/6:00/5:00). Give swing_density explicit 'requires swing.step >= n' entry gates. Either let Saturday DB-swing rounds count as swing sessions (10 rounds >= target reps) or state explicitly that only Thursday logs feed swing steps 1-7 and only Saturday logs feed density steps.

issues.issue: Boss Battle 2 at week 4 requires 5 minutes of max continuous two-hand swings from users who, by the program's own gating, have never been allowed a continuous swing.
issues.evidence: bb_swings_5min protocol: 'Two-hand swings to chest height, any rest scheme, 5-min cap ... Implement = the user's current swing ladder implement: 20 lb DB ... Never a deadlift fallback.' Placement: 'swing always 1'. Simulation: all-1 user is at swing step 1 (hike-and-park, 'No swing yet') in week 4; even a seeded-2 hinge user is at swing step 2 (dead-stop singles). deload_rules Saturday script includes 'swings 5 min' unconditionally. A coach would not have a person who has never swung do a 5-minute max-rep swing test.
issues.fix: Gate the test: if swing.step < 3, replace with '5-min dead-stop swing count' (park between every rep, checklist enforced) capped at recruit, or with 'hike-and-park reps' scored 0 and shown as 'locked: earn swing step 3'. Encode as a 'requires' expression on the benchmark, not prose.

issues.issue: Week-4 mile time trial contradicts the RUN GATE and the +10%/week running rule.
issues.evidence: bb_mile_time: '1.00 mile as fast as possible, walk/run mix allowed' at week 4. Safety gate 5: 'intervals locked at brisk-walk step 1 until treadmill_zone2.step >= 2 and 2 weeks elapsed; jogging only at step 3 with no shin/knee pain flag; running minutes rise <= 10%/week'. Simulation: intervals step 2 at earliest w3, step 3 (first jogging) at w5. So the first sanctioned jog is a max-effort mile. Health-screen lock is stated for intervals but not for the mile test.
issues.fix: Add benchmark 'requires': mile test is walk-only (tier capped at soldier) unless treadmill_intervals.step >= 3; health-screen 'yes' locks the mile test the same as intervals. Alternatively make the week-4 test a 1-mile brisk walk time and the week-8/12 tests run/walk.

issues.issue: advance_when, gates, placement quiz, phase parameters and deload multipliers are prose, not data; the app cannot evaluate them without a human transcribing every string into code.
issues.evidence: progression_rules defines a grammar only for 'target'. advance_when values include 34 distinct free-text forms, e.g. 'completed 12 sessions' (warmup_flow.1), 'completed pain-free x2' (neck 1-2), '0 drops x2' (TGU.2), 'all reps clean x2' (TGU.3-6, 'clean' undefined), 'x3 (terminal)' (TGU.7, no condition at all), 'all holds >= target x2', 'completed at RPE <= 4 x2 -> intervals may advance past step 1', 'completed with hard reps RPE >= 6 x2 AND treadmill_zone2.step >= 2' plus how-text 'and 2 weeks elapsed', 'completed x2, no shin/knee pain flag', '100 in <= 5:00 x2 AND no low-back pain flag in 14 days -> one-hand unlocked'. The placement quiz (Q1-Q8), phase RIR (3/2/1), eccentric tempo, Zone-2 minutes (30/33/36), interval step ranges, deload multipliers (0.6, RIR 4, 70% Zone-2) and the vest % rules live only inside 'progression_rules', 'phases[].what_changes', 'deload_rules' and 'safety_and_form_gates' strings. Template items carry phase behaviour in 'notes' ('Phase 1: 3 s eccentric', 'Phase 3: last set RIR 0').
issues.fix: Replace advance_when with a structured object: {"metric": "reps|seconds|rounds|time|checklist|drops|rpe", "op": ">=|<=", "value": n, "per": "set|side|letter|direction", "consecutive": 2, "requires": [{"exercise": "hinge_deadlift", "step": 6}], "no_pain_region_days": {"region": "low_back", "days": 14}, "min_week": 3, "unlocks": ["vest:push_up"]}. Add 'entry_requires' on each step. Add phases[].params {rir, eccentric_s, zone2_min, interval_steps, set_multiplier}. Add a 'placement' table: [{question, answer, sets: {exercise: step}}]. Add 'deload' params object. Remove behaviour from 'notes'.

issues.issue: 11 ladder targets do not parse under the program's own target grammar, and 'each arm', 'each direction', 'each letter' and the space-joined checklist suffix are undefined.
issues.evidence: Grammar in progression_rules: 'SxR', 'SxA-B', 'SxR each side', 'SxNs', 'SxA-Bs', 'NxR EMOM', 'N min RPE <= k', 'N rounds', '100 in <= m:ss', 'checklist n/N', compound joined by ' + '. Non-parsing targets: warmup_flow.1/.2 '6 min'; cooldown_flow.1 'prescribed min'; prone_ytw.1-4 '2x8 each letter' etc.; neck_isometrics.3 '1x15 each', .4 '1x25 each'; turkish_get_up.2 '4x1 each side, 0 drops'; turkish_get_up.7 '5x1 each side in <= 10:00'. Undefined qualifiers used: 'each arm' (db_curl.6, db_hammer_curl.5), 'each direction' (neck 1-2), and 'checklist 5/5' appended with a space (hinge_deadlift.1/.5, swing.1/.2/.6, TGU.1 '3/3'), not with ' + '.
issues.fix: Extend the grammar to list every allowed qualifier ('each side|each arm|each letter|each direction'), define 'N min' as a time target, define checklist as a separate structured field ('checklist_required': 5), rewrite TGU.2 as target '4x1 each side' + 'max_drops': 0, TGU.7 as '5x1 each side' + 'time_cap': '10:00', cooldown as 'terminal, no target'. Add a unit test that every target parses.

issues.issue: Steps that span two loads cannot be evaluated: the per-set log schema has no load field.
issues.evidence: progression_rules LOGGING: 'reps or seconds (or rounds/time), RIR 0-4, pain 0-10, checklist ticks' -- no load. Yet advance_when depends on load: db_curl.2 'all sets >= 15 at 12 lb x2' (how '10 lb then 12 lb'), db_hammer_curl.1 'at 10 lb', single_leg_rdl.3 'at 12 lb', prone_ytw.4 'at 12 lb', hip_thrust.7 'at 35 lb', leg_raise.5 'at 12 lb', hollow_hold.7 'at 12 lb', plus '8-10 lb' in db_floor_press.1 and db_triceps_extension.1 and '8-12 in' step_up.1. Pain rules need body region ('no low-back pain flag in 14 days', 'no shin/knee pain flag') but pain is a bare 0-10.
issues.fix: Either split each dual-load step into two steps (cleanest: 10 lb step then 12 lb step, each x2) or add 'load_lb' to the per-set log and a 'load' field on each step. Add 'pain_region' enum to the log (low_back, shoulder, knee, shin, wrist, neck, other) and add 'rpe' to cardio logs (Zone-2 'RPE <= 4' and interval 'RPE >= 6' are currently unloggable).

issues.issue: Vest-gate expressions are off by one relative to the ladders that grant the unlock, and split_squat unlocks the vest with nothing behind it.
issues.evidence: push_up.5 advance_when 'all sets >= 20 x2 -> vest unlocked' (unlock occurs on reaching step 6) but safety gate 4 says 'push_up.step >= 5'. Same pattern: goblet_squat.8 -> unlock vs '>= 8'; step_up.3 -> unlock vs '>= 3'; plank_side_plank.4 -> unlock vs '>= 4'; pike_push_up.4 -> unlock vs '>= 4'; split_squat.2 -> unlock vs '>= 2'. split_squat's first vest use is step 8 ('or 35 lb + vest'), so 'vest unlocked for lunges' at bodyweight reverse lunges (week ~3) is meaningless. hinge_deadlift.8 how says 'Requires vest gate' (which one?) while gate text says 'requires vest_walk.step >= 1'; if every exercise's current_step defaults to 1 this is trivially true, if vest_walk is seeded at 0 ('locked') the '>= 1' semantics are undefined.
issues.fix: Make each gate an explicit 'unlocks' field on the step whose completion grants it, and evaluate 'vest:<exercise>' as a boolean flag rather than a step comparison; or correct every expression to 'step >= (unlock step + 1)'. Remove the split_squat.2 unlock or move it to step 7. Seed vest_walk.current_step = 0 and define step 0 = locked in the data model; change hinge_deadlift.8 to 'requires vest_walk.step >= 2' (one vest walk block completed).

issues.issue: Five 53 lb ladder steps carry no machine-readable gate although safety text says they require hinge_deadlift.step >= 5, and 53 lb goblet/split-squat/step-up loads are not gated anywhere.
issues.evidence: safety_and_form_gates 3: 'any 53 lb step in rows, shrugs, carries, SL RDL, calf, hip thrust requires hinge_deadlift.step >= 5'. Ladder data: db_row.6, db_shrug.5, suitcase_carry.4, farmer_carry.4, single_leg_rdl.7 carry 'Requires hinge_deadlift.step >= 5' in 'how'; hip_thrust.6 ('Hip thrust + 53 lb KB') and calf_raise.6 ('Single-leg + 53 lb KB') do not. goblet_squat.8 ('53 lb KB goblet'), split_squat.8 ('Bulgarian + 53 lb goblet'), step_up.6 ('or 53 lb goblet') have no gate in either place. Since the app evaluates gate expressions from ladder data, these are unenforced.
issues.fix: Add 'entry_requires': [{"exercise":"hinge_deadlift","step":5}] to hip_thrust.6, calf_raise.6, goblet_squat.8, split_squat.8, step_up.6 (and keep the existing ones as structured fields). Decide whether picking up the bell for a goblet requires the hinge gate (it should: the pickup is a 53 lb deadlift).

issues.issue: Placement quiz maps to non-existent rungs and overshoots on push-ups.
issues.evidence: Q7: 'no -> treadmill_zone2 1 at 20 min building to 30' -- there is no 20-min rung; step 1 target is '30 min RPE <= 4', so a user who cannot walk 20 min comfortably gets a 30-min target and can only close the gap via 'beat last time by >= 1 total rep' (+1 min/Wednesday = 10 weeks). Q1: '10+ -> push_up 5' but step 5 target is '3x15-20' and the template prescribes 4 sets; a user with a 10-rep max is told to do 4x15 on day one. Q5 seeds db_floor_press 1 or 2 but step 1 already says '8 lb (10 lb if 8 lb is trivially easy at placement)' -- a within-step load choice with no data field. calf_raise, neck_isometrics, prone_ytw, warmup_flow, cooldown_flow, vest_walk, treadmill_intervals have no quiz rule and no stated default.
issues.fix: Add treadmill_zone2 steps '3.0 mph 0%, 20 min' and '3.0 mph 1%, 25 min' before the current step 1 (renumber and update the gate references zone2 >= 2 / >= 4 accordingly). Change Q1: 10-14 -> push_up 4, 15+ -> 5. Split db_floor_press.1 into 8 lb and 10 lb steps. State 'default current_step = 1 for any exercise not named by the quiz; vest_walk = 0 (locked)'.

issues.issue: Progression algorithm has undefined states: advance vs SESSION SUCCESS, deload sessions in the consecutive counter, prescribed reps as floor or cap, dropped sets under the time guard.
issues.evidence: SESSION SUCCESS requires 'RIR >= phase minimum minus 1' but advance_when strings never mention RIR, so it is undefined whether a set of 15 at RIR 0 in Phase 1 counts toward 'all sets >= 15 x2'. 'x2 = 2 consecutive logged sessions'; deload weeks log sessions at 0.6 sets/RIR 4 with 'no ladder advances evaluated' -- unstated whether they break or preserve the streak. 'SxA-B: prescribe A on the first session' then 'beat last time by >= 1 total rep': if A is a cap, reaching B takes (S*(B-A)) sessions (push_up.1: 3x10 -> 45 needs 15 sessions); if it is a floor, A is meaningless. 'at 50 min the app drops the last strength-B set' -- whether the dropped set is 'prescribed' for the all-sets rule is undefined.
issues.fix: Define: advance requires SESSION SUCCESS on N consecutive counted sessions; deload/test-week and time-guard-trimmed sessions are 'not counted' (streak preserved); prescription is a range A-B with instruction 'stop at phase RIR, log actual', threshold B; the time guard marks dropped sets as 'not prescribed'. Put these as explicit rule fields, not prose.

issues.issue: Monday strength-B and Wednesday Phase-3 blocks exceed their minute budgets once tempo and rest are applied; Wednesday Phase 3 exceeds 50 min.
issues.evidence: Mon strength B is 15 min: split_squat 3 sets x 2 sides x ~40 s + 60 s rest = ~6 min; calf_raise 3x15-25 with '2 s squeeze at the top, 3 s down' = ~6 s/rep -> 90-150 s/set + 45 s rest = ~8-10 min; hollow_hold 3 x (30 s + 30 s) = 3 min -> 17-19 min. Mon strength A is 16 min: goblet 4 x (15 reps x 4 s + 90 s) = 10 min + hinge 3 x (15 x 4 s + 90 s) = 7.5 min -> 17.5. Wed: conditioning block fixed at 32 min but reps_or_time says 'P3 36'; note claims 'get-up block shrinks to 6 min in P3' -> 3+36+6+4+2 = 51 min; four 20-35 lb get-ups per side at ~35 s each plus 45 s rests is ~7 min, not 6.
issues.fix: Cut calf_raise to 2 sets on Monday (or cap at 3x15-20 with 2 s down), set split_squat rest to 45 s, and re-declare Mon strength B = 17 / strength A = 17 with the Zone-2 finisher trimmed to 5 min. Wednesday P3: 36-min Zone 2 with TGU at 3 sets/side (6 min) and cooldown 2 -> 50 exactly, or hold Wednesday Zone 2 at 33 min in P3 and put the extra 3 min in the Sunday walk. Encode block minutes per phase, not a single number with a prose override.

issues.issue: Cardio-specific rules reference quantities the data model does not carry: '2 weeks elapsed', 'running minutes rise <= 10%/week', treadmill max incline fallback.
issues.evidence: treadmill_intervals.1 how: 'Locked here until treadmill_zone2.step >= 2 and 2 weeks elapsed' (no 'week' term in the gate grammar). interval_engine: 'Running minutes never rise more than 10% week to week' but ladder jumps step 3 (8 x 1 min jog = 8 min) -> step 4 (10 x 1 min run = 10 min, +25%) -> step 6 (4 x 3 min = 12 min, +20% from step 5's 7.5 min) contradict it. treadmill_intervals.2 needs 10%, treadmill_zone2.6 needs 12%, vest_walk.5 needs 10-12%; onboarding records max incline but no rule handles a treadmill that tops out at 10%.
issues.fix: Add 'min_week' to the gate grammar (intervals.1: min_week 3). Either delete the 10% sentence or make the ladder obey it (step 4: 9 x 1 min; step 6: 3 x 3 min). Add an equipment rule: if required incline > treadmill max, substitute max incline and +0.3 mph, flagged in the step name.

issues.issue: Benchmark scoring arithmetic and goblet-load rule are inconsistent.
issues.evidence: progression_rules DUO MODE: 'combined tier points of both users vs a shared target (week 4: 8, week 8: 12, week 12: 16 of 24 max)' -- 6 benchmarks x 4 points x 2 users = 48 combined max; 24 is per user. bb_goblet_bw name says '~30% bodyweight', protocol says '<= 35% of bodyweight'; fallback 'test one implement lighter and cap at soldier' is undefined when the user's ladder is two implements below (120 lb Cat at goblet step 3 = 12 lb: target 35 lb, 'one lighter' = 20 lb, also not reached). XP '+5 per Zone-2 minute /10' is ambiguous (0.5/min or 5 per 10 min).
issues.fix: State 'of 48 combined max' (or targets 16/24/32). Goblet test: 'load = heaviest implement <= 35% BW that the user's goblet ladder has reached; if that is below the % BW implement, cap tier at soldier'. Write XP as '0.5 XP per Zone-2 minute'.

issues.issue: Minor coach-level inconsistencies: calves trained once a week despite 'every visible muscle twice weekly'; warm-up asks for 'push-ups one step easier' at push_up step 1; TGU 'clean' undefined; single-arm 53 lb floor press 'other hand braces floor' conflicts with 'free hand on ribs' cue; 'stair' in step_up.1 is not in the equipment list.
issues.evidence: calf_raise only in Mon strength B. Tue warm-up notes '8 push-ups one step easier than working step' with no step 0. turkish_get_up.3-6 advance 'all reps clean x2' with checklist only defined on step 1. db_floor_press cue 'Single-DB: free hand on ribs' vs step 7 how 'other hand braces floor'. step_up.1 name 'couch cushion / stair, 8-12 in'.
issues.fix: Add 2 sets of calf_raise to Thu strength B (or accept and delete the 2x/week claim for calves). Warm-up rule: 'if step 1, do 8 wall push-ups at a closer stance'. Define clean = TGU checklist 3/3 on every step. Align the floor-press cue. Replace 'stair' with 'bottom couch cushion on the floor (8-12 in)'.
